notes.title: Fixes, Price Update & More Assorted Potassium!
notes.content:
Greetings, comrades.

A few updates.

> Major fix on the semi sentient bushes' health
> Fixed scrolling wheel zooming camera
> Price update coming soon; buy the game for the price of a terrible coffee*

*equivalent to 3 years' pay in median Neo Kazakh wages

If you want to play a game that might actually be good, follow Iwa Interactive on social media and watch for updates.

[url=https://www.iwainteractive.com/gamedevprojects]https://www.iwainteractive.com/gamedevprojects[/url]

notes.title: Quality/Bug Fix Update 1 - Platforming/No Damage Achievement Update
notes.content:
- Updated horizontal movement deceleration for more precise platforming
- Fixed a bug relating to the triggering of an achievement (completing a level without taking damage)
